commands.title: Jira Copilot: Set Personal Access Token

jiraCopilot.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Jira instance (e.g. https://jira.mycompany.com)

jiraCopilot.authType.description: Authentication mode: 'datacenter' uses Bearer PAT, 'cloud' uses Basic email:apiToken

jiraCopilot.requiredFields.description: Field names that must be set for ticket validation (e.g. ["assignee", "priority"])

jiraCopilot.defaultProject.description: Default Jira project key (e.g. 'VSJI'). Used when creating tickets if no project is specified in your prompt.
